related_questions.question: What credit card company is Elan Financial Services?

text_blocks.snippet: Elan Financial Services is a credit card company that provides outsourced credit card programs for banks and credit unions. They are not a direct-to-consumer credit card issuer but rather partner with other financial institutions to offer credit cards under their brand names. Essentially, Elan acts as the issuer and processor for these partner institutions.

list.title: Partnering with Banks and Credit Unions:
list.snippet: Elan Financial Services works with over 1,400 financial institutions, providing them with the infrastructure and support to offer credit card programs to their customers.

list.title: Issuing and Processing:
list.snippet: Elan handles the behind-the-scenes work of credit card issuance, including processing applications, managing accounts, and handling transactions.

list.title: Not a Direct-to-Consumer Brand:
list.snippet: You won't typically see a credit card with the "Elan Financial Services" name on it. Instead, the card will be branded with the name of the bank or credit union that partners with Elan.

list.title: Examples:
list.snippet: If you have a credit card from CorePlus Credit Union, Preferred Bank, or Mokelumne Federal Credit Union, Elan Financial Services is likely the company behind the scenes issuing and processing that card.

list.title: Benefits of the Partnership:
list.snippet: Elan provides financial institutions with a way to offer credit card programs without having to build the infrastructure themselves, allowing them to focus on serving their customers.
